author: @ozzysaritas
text:
The list deserves some honorable mentions I think:

- Typhus with Relic is insane on those Psycher tracks.
- Aesoth is pretty good with every 2 turn damage reduction active and a less powerful Tyrant Guard aura. Also probably will be already built because of Raids.
- Baldyr with Relic is pretty good.
- Tan Gida (and Actus) is a glaring omission. Actus is more dependant on fitting on a track with Tan or Revas but when he does, it's pretty broken.
- This one is less so but a well built Gibbascraps usually fit in with Mythic Snot tracks and have pretty good synergy with armor, heal and a strong tank. I think he needs to be Mythic with the Relic but when he is, it's basically like a worse Aleph.
- A G1 Titus literally solo carries Chain tracks up to 8. Which is the highest ROI LRE investment in the game I think.
- This is also less so, but a well built Angrax with few spawn points and/or the new Cezare look promising.

author: @MidnightHozz
text:
Tough to make a list like this, limiting it to 10.  I would not have Dreir in the top 10.  He looks really good on paper but I've got him at Mythic D3 with a 4/10 Saber and he still can't keep himself alive too well.  The summon logic is also wonky, preferring attacks vs # of summons for the purpose of determining the hex he lands on.  This can screw you out of 1-2 death riders more often than you might think.

The one you have missing that 100% makes my top 10 is Typhus with relic.  IMO he's a top 5 anytime he matches a scoring track because of the relic.  Once his aura gets to 3 hexes he generates 3 poxes a turn as long as your team can just kill three things.  Would literally not leave home without him.
